title: Escaping the hotel
content: So every time I’ve been in the hotel wandering around, I’ve always had a hard time finding my way back out, for some reason I decided to pull the fire alarm one time which obviously set off really loud alarms and sent the staff into panic but the 2 times I did that I was immediately able to run down the hall away from the alarm and see the double doors and run outside. Anybody else experience this or something similar? It never feels evil or hostile, it just seems like I genuinely get lost until I pull the alarm and then all of a sudden everything makes sense and I remember where I’m at.
